claims.claim: Ibc tank for storage of water or any liquid very strong and durable
claims.evidence: Witness report shows IBC tanks with metal cages and caps, but does not confirm durability or suitability for all liquids.
Witness report does not show any food-grade/NSF/approval markings or documentation.

claims.claim: Used only once for clean water
claims.evidence: Witness report does not show usage history, cleaning records, or internal condition.

claims.claim: No crack, no leak, lids complete
claims.evidence: Witness report does not include close-ups/testing for cracks/leaks; it only notes a round black cap on top and that lids appear present.

risks.risk: Not actually food-grade / unknown prior contents (could be chemical or non-food use). This affects buyer safety and allowable use.
risks.proof: A clear photo of any food-grade/NSF/approval markings on the IBC (e.g., stamp/label on the cage or plastic) plus a photo of the label/previous contents if available.
risks.if_unproven: Price as chemical/unknown-grade IBC (worst case) and treat as not guaranteed for potable water.

risks.risk: Hidden leaks or micro-cracks in the plastic bladder or fittings (may not be visible in the single angle).
risks.proof: A short clip showing the tank filled to a visible level (or a pressure/leak test) and a close-up of the bottom outlet/valve area with no seepage.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially leaking/untested; assume buyer may need replacement of valve/cap or will use only after inspection.

risks.risk: Cap/valve sealing condition and outlet/spigot availability (may be missing or worn).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the top cap threads and the bottom outlet/valve/spigot (if present), including a shot showing the outlet fully intact.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/untested sealing hardware (worst case) until confirmed.

risks.risk: Capacity/size mismatch or unknown liters per unit (affects per-liter value).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the capacity rating (e.g., “1000L” or liters) on the label/sticker for the foreground tank and one other unit.
risks.if_unproven: Price as the most common but unconfirmed capacity; adjust downward if capacity is not the expected standard.

risks.risk: Quantity uncertainty (how many complete usable units).
risks.proof: A wide shot showing the full count of IBCs and a quick check that each has a cage + cap + intact bladder.
risks.if_unproven: Price assuming only the photographed foreground unit is confirmed usable; treat others as unverified until counted.

proof_requests: Send a close-up photo of the IBC label/stamp showing grade/approval (food-grade/NSF or equivalent) and any compliance markings.
Send a clear photo of the capacity rating (liters) for the foreground tank and at least one other tank.
Send close-ups of the top cap threads and the bottom outlet/valve/spigot (showing whether it’s present and intact).
Send a short video clip demonstrating the cap/valve sealing (e.g., after filling or a leak test) with no drips.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies the item type as IBC cube tanks branded “EMMALINK CONCEPT NIG,” so it can be priced at its worst-case assumptions. However, food-grade status, prior contents, leak-free condition, and capacity are not verifiable from the report, so the price should reflect the highest risk until proof is provided.
